title: Production Lead Times, Expediting and Holds by Programme
content:
# Production Lead Times, Expediting and Holds by Programme

The atelier's production parameters for Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions, by programme: the business days between the deposit clearing and production finishing; the business days production runs to when the commission is expedited; the surcharge for expediting as a percentage of the quoted total; the calendar days of notice needed before a commission can be expedited; the calendar days a commission may sit on hold before it is treated as cancelled; and whether the customer signs off the finished piece before it leaves the studio.

## Table

| Programme | Production lead time (business days) | Expedited production (business days) | Expediting surcharge (share of quoted total) | Notice needed to expedite (calendar days) | Longest hold (calendar days) | Customer signs off the finished piece |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | 20 | 10 | 18 per cent | 14 | 60 | no |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | 25 | 12 | 18 per cent | 14 | 60 | no |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | 35 | 18 | 22 per cent | 21 | 90 | yes |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | 50 | 25 | 25 per cent | 30 | 120 | yes |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | 45 | 22 | 22 per cent | 28 | 90 | yes |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | 75 | 35 | 30 per cent | 45 | 180 | yes |

## Notes

- Lead times and expedited lead times are counted in business days; notice and holds are counted in calendar days.
- Customer sign-off of the finished piece is part of Belrose Bespoke Design, the Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission, the Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission and the Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission, and not of either Design Studio programme.
- Expediting a Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission quoted at a hypothetical USD 20000.00 carries a surcharge of 25 per cent of the quoted total, USD 5000.00, and brings production to 25 business days in place of 50.
